🌟 vpn-configurator | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Configuring WireGuard AllowedIPs for split tunneling using AmneziaWG.
✨ Key Features: • Include / exclude strategies with CIDR merge and subtract (IPv4 + IPv6) • System IP lists (YouTube, ChatGPT, Discord, Telegram, …) as locked URL entries • Manual and custom URL sources • Multiple configs with autosave
📖 Summary: This is a client-only web application built with TypeScript and Vite that helps users configure AllowedIPs for AmneziaWG/WireGuard VPNs. It allows users to select inclusion/exclusion strategies, integrate system service lists, and add manual CIDRs to generate a single, clean line of configuration for their VPN peer settings, all stored locally in the browser.
